
But because `import jwtDecode from "jwt-decode"` was imported as a default import in `spec/unit/oidc/authorize.spec.ts`, under `tsc --noEmit`:

Wait, yes! In TypeScript, if a module has no default export, then `import foo from "bar"` is only allowed with `allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true` or `esModuleInterop: true`. And `MockedObject` of a module object does NOT have `.mockReturnValue` directly on it! (Though its fields like `.jwtDecode` would, but the tests call `mocked(jwtDecode).mockReturnValue`!).
